items.title: NATIVE: a statement-form `expr is Some(let x) else jump break;` DROPS its binding - the emitted Rust is `if let Some(x) = .. {} else { break; }`, so a later use of `x` is rustc E0425 where node prints the value
items.kind: native backend defect (cargo refuses; a let-else lowering)
items.discussion: lane http-56 (Order 56): repro scratchpad/http-56/find/guard.vl (prints 6 on node, refused natively); the lane used `match` instead
items.body: Lower the statement-form guard to Rust's `let Some(x) = .. else { break; };` (let-else), which keeps the binding in scope; pin on the native differential with `jump break`, `jump continue` and `ret` in the else arm. Sizing S.

items.title: std::crypto has no incremental digest, and native `createHash` buffers everything it is fed - a streamed 64 MiB body cannot be hashed at a bounded peak (M176's pin hashes 256 KiB blocks and then the list of block digests)
items.discussion: lane http-56 (Order 56): the 64 MiB stream pin had to hash block digests to keep the RSS bound honest; a `Hasher` with `update(bytes)` / `finish()` is the shape every other std has
items.body: Rec: `crypto::Hasher::new(algorithm)`, `update(self, bytes)`, `finish(own self): Bytes`, both backends (node's `createHash` IS incremental - the std wrapper buffers; natively a streaming SHA-2); `hash(bytes)` stays as the one-shot. Pin: the M176 64 MiB stream hashed incrementally equals the whole-body hash, RSS bounded. Sizing S.
